thread.text: Hi Meera, thanks for your enquiry with Brightpath Studio. Can we help?
Hi, how much does a modular kitchen cost?
Hi Rahul, thanks for your enquiry with Brightpath Studio. Can we help?
Can you send me your brochure please?
Hi Sneha, would you like a free site visit from our designer?
Haan, Saturday 11 am ko site visit kar sakte ho? Kokapet mein flat hai
Hi Vikram, a modular kitchen is ₹3,80,000 for a standard size.
Thoda discount milega kya? Budget tight hai
Hi Anita, our designer will visit tomorrow at 11 am.
Your designer never showed up and nobody called. This is really unprofessional.
Hi Karan, thanks for your enquiry. Can we help?
Am I talking to a bot?
Hi Karan, thanks for your enquiry. Can we help?
Am I talking to a bot?
Hi Deepa, thanks for your enquiry with Brightpath Studio. Can we help?
Do you also do projects in Bangalore?
Hi Farhan, did you get a chance to look at the quote?
Thanks, but we went ahead with another studio.
Hi Pooja, just checking in about your kitchen.
STOP
Hi Srinivas, would you like a free site visit?
Naaku interest ledu andi, inka messages cheyakandi
Hi Nikhil, thanks for your enquiry. Can we help?
Roughly what would a full 3BHK interior cost?
Hi Lakshmi, could you tell me a little about your home?
It's a villa in Gachibowli, possession on 2027-03-15. Budget is 1500000.
Hi Sunita, thanks for your enquiry with Brightpath Studio. Can we help?
नमस्ते, क्या आप किचन का डिज़ाइन भी करते हैं?
Hi Ravi, thanks for your enquiry. Can we help?
If I sign today, will my kitchen be ready by Diwali?
Hey Aditi, thanks for checking out Northstar! Want to hop on a free 20-min discovery call?
Is the programme online or offline?
Hey Rohan, thanks for checking out Northstar! Want to hop on a free 20-min discovery call?
Fees kitni hai programme ki?
Hey Imran, thanks for checking out Northstar! Want to hop on a free 20-min discovery call?
Will I definitely get a better job and a 30% hike after this?
Hey Shruti, want to hop on a free 20-min discovery call?
Ho, mala call var bolayla avdel. Tuesday 6 pm la jamel ka?
Hey Manish, how are the sessions going?
Honestly it's useless, I want my money back. I joined 5 weeks ago.
Hey Neha, thanks for checking out Northstar!
Can you share the syllabus first?
Hey Tarun, great talking to you today!
My company might sponsor it. Can someone send an invoice to our HR?
Hey Kriti, just following up on the discovery call.
not interested anymore, thanks
Hey Varun, want to hop on a free 20-min discovery call?
Who am I talking to? Is this automated?
Hello Riya, thank you for contacting Clearleaf Skin Clinic. How may we help?
What cream should I apply for my acne? It's getting worse.
Hello Sameer, thank you for contacting Clearleaf Skin Clinic. How may we help?
Consultation fees kitni hai?
Hello Gauri, thank you for contacting Clearleaf Skin Clinic. How may we help?
Where exactly is the clinic and what are the timings?
Hello Pallavi, how are you feeling after the session?
My face is burning and red since the peel yesterday. Is this normal??
Hello Omkar, would you like to book a consultation with our dermatologist?
Ho, Saturday 11 am la appointment milel ka?
Hello Tanvi, thank you for contacting Clearleaf Skin Clinic. How may we help?
Is laser hair removal painful? And how much does it cost?
Hello Ajay, just checking whether you'd like to book a consultation.
Please don't message me again.
Hi Suresh, thanks for your interest in Greenfield Riverside, Kharadi. Can we help?
What's the price of a 2BHK?
Hi Kavita, thanks for your interest in Greenfield Riverside. Can we help?
Floor plan bhej do please
Hi Harish, the 3 BHK is ₹1,15,00,000 all inclusive.
Will this flat double in value in 5 years? Is it a good investment?
Hi Nisha, would you like to visit the site?
Can we come this Sunday at 11 am?
Hi Prakash, thanks for your interest in Greenfield Riverside. Can we help?
Is the project RERA registered? When is possession?
Hi Mahesh, thanks for your interest in Greenfield Riverside. Can we help?
Mera budget 80 lakh hai, kuch milega?
Hi Jyoti, thanks for visiting Riverside! Any questions?
Thanks, but we already bought a flat in Wagholi.
Hi Anil, your booking documents are ready.
There's a clause in the agreement I don't agree with. I'll take legal action if it isn't changed.
مرحبا خالد، شكرا لتواصلك مع Pulse Fitness. كيف يمكننا مساعدتك؟
كم سعر الاشتراك الشهري؟
Hi Faisal, thanks for reaching out to Pulse Fitness JLT. How can we help?
Habibi how much for personal training?
مرحبا مريم، هل تودين حجز حصة تجريبية مجانية؟
نعم، يوم السبت الساعة 7 مساء مناسب؟
Hi Daniel, thanks for reaching out to Pulse Fitness JLT. How can we help?
If I join, will I lose 10 kg in a month?
مرحبا يوسف، هل ما زلت مهتما بالحصة التجريبية؟
لا تراسلني مرة أخرى
Hi Aisha, thanks for reaching out to Pulse Fitness JLT. How can we help?
Do you have ladies only sessions?
Hi Omar, how was your trial session?
Honestly the trainer was rude to me and ignored me half the time.
Hi Leila, thanks for reaching out to Pulse Fitness JLT. How can we help?
Is this a real person or a bot?
